patches.notes:
What's new:
• 44 new attack animations: elemental slams for giants and elementals (fire, frost, water, earth, wind, lightning, nature, shadow, cosmic and sweet)
• Blades and weapons: axe cleave, sword slash, dagger stabs, scythe reap, spear throw, shuriken, goblin bomb, lasso, missile strike and a magic trick
• Creatures: bite, pounce and rake, horn charge, burrow, bounce squash, shell spin, roar, tail smash, bubbles, ink, constrict, web shot and laser eyes
• Spells and spirits: dark orb blast, soul drain, hellfire, holy smite, fairy dust, meteor shower, black hole, heart blast, tractor beam and bone toss
• Most Spirits and Leaders now get an animation that fits their class; any card can pick one in the card editor
• Flooding and Bubble Wand now last through the opponent's whole next turn (they wore off as it began)
